name: Freedom Bridge and the White Nile crossing
subtitle: The Freedom Bridge is a steel arch bridge over the Nile in Juba, opened in 2022.

facts.label: Type
facts.value: 560 m long, first arched steel bridge in the country to span the Nile

facts.label: Old bridge
facts.value: Juba Bridge was the only existing Nile bridge in Juba, prefabricated about 50 years earlier (summary)

parts.text: The Freedom Bridge is a steel arch bridge over the Nile in Juba, opened in 2022. It supplements the older Juba Bridge, a prefabricated crossing.

gaps: The description is summarised from the sources listed here and should be read against them.
